name: @reactunity/monorepo
//typescript: Held at 6.x, not the 7.0 release, and the whole workspace is pinned to the same range on purpose. TypeScript 7 is the native compiler: it ships no JS API, so `resolve.sync('typescript')` fails outright -- which breaks react-unity-scripts (packages/scripts/config/modules.js) and fork-ts-checker-webpack-plugin behind it, and stops `astro check` in docs. It also removed `target: ES5`, which packages/renderer and packages/material emit for Unity's embedded JS engines. Raise this once those three can run on 7.
